I'd say is more readable and natural, for all

This bounding should be lowered, it is handled by `Control::get_bound_minimum_size()`
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/070dc9897ea1b84ab2a7ec04b9bc1b94f38a0eaf/scene/gui/control.cpp#L2145-L2158

I think the if else could be removed by instead using size indices (in order to not have the same code twice, makes reading easier and saves us from having to remember to duplicate bugfixes), similarly to how `SplitContainer` handles it:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a4f5e8cddf68487bdc358bc2ccf745d98363139b/scene/gui/split_container.cpp#L1076-L1094

Whilst it is the exception in our codebase, ideally, they should all be this way.

You might still need some branching for things that do not have a full-size returning method and only have `get_height`/`get_width` (although I don't think that should be the case for any.

Same here, some of the things might be able to be extracted from branching paths. Looking at it though, it might be harder and/or messier to do so compared to `tab_bar.cpp`, so I leave the judgment up to you, worth trying and seeing at least.

I don't think these methods are necessary or a good idea. 
In every case, you can just check `pos == POSITION_LEFT || pos == POSITION_RIGHT` (for example), since you are in `TabContainer` methods. You also end up using a lot of `if ... else if` statements, when the `else if` can just be an `else`, as tabs will always be horizontal or vertical.

And if you want to make it extra clear which branch is which, you can use something like what `box_container.cpp` has all over the place, e.g.:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a4f5e8cddf68487bdc358bc2ccf745d98363139b/scene/gui/box_container.cpp#L74-L85

Before changing it, let's see what the maintainers think. @AThousandShips thoughts?
